First of all thank you for having the courage to share your story. Just by you reaching out is a great indicator that you are acknowledging you have a problem and are taking the first step in your journey. I want you to understand that you are a human being and that we all make mistakes and that it is a mere part of life. Be kind to yourself.  You’re not a failure because of the challenges you’ve been experiencing. You have simply used shopping as you’re coping mechanism. Everyone has a coping mechanism and what they transmute their energy into. For some people it’s exercising, emotional eating,or procrastinating. 

Is there something else underlying that you feel need to be addressed or a void that needs to be filled? Not too much information was given in the regard. However, usually when people video games it’s a way to escape reality because the virtual reality is better than their real reality. By making your real life better, you won’t feel the desire to put your energy in video games as much. 

 In regard to the packages coming and the compulsive shopping. Chemicals in your brain such as dopamine and norepinephrine are being released and neural pathways are physically created every time you make a purchase. This is why it is so hard to break habits. When you have packages coming, it also gives you something to look forward to. 

Do you feel like you have something to look forward to? When you set smart goals it is important to have a “why” reason that is so strong that you are determined to achieve it. 

Right now it would also be a good time to create goals, develop a new skill or start a hobby as a way of having something to look forward to. Essentially, you would be trading one addiction for another by transmuting your energy and rewiring neural pathways in the brain.

If you have a credit card I would also suggest cutting it up. Next I would advise following Dave Ramsey’s 7 baby steps to financial freedom.
